people.name: Carmel_Mount
people.line: Mountain range; site of Elijah's confrontation with prophets of Baal

people.name: Gehazi
people.line: Elisha's servant; punished with leprosy for greed and deceit.

people.name: Shunammites
people.line: People from Shunem; includes Abishag and the Shunammite woman

translations.web: So she went, and came to the man of God to Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her afar off, he said to Gehazi his servant, “Behold, there is the Shunammite.
translations.bsb: So she set out and went to the man of God at Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her at a distance, he said to his servant Gehazi, “Look, there is the Shunammite woman.
translations.kjv: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:
